goal: Prevent spent coins from incorrectly reappearing as locked after restarting the wallet
Fixes wallet state when a temporary coin lock is upgraded to persistent before being spent
agreement: Concept approval noting upgrading lock persistence in a single call provides good UX (vicjuma)
Verified by manual testing that the solution works as expected (vicjuma)

categories.name: wallet
why: P3 because it fixes an edge-case bug where upgraded locks leave ghost locks after restart
Confusing wallet state occurs but there is no risk of fund loss or database corruption
